notes.title: Deer to all players, and About the game release schedule
notes.notes:
[b]Hello!
I'm Eui-soo, Jin developer of Morning Bird Studio.[/b]

Morning Bird Studio is currently a one-man indie game developer,
I'm developing Flow of Sound, which will be released this year.

I didn't reveal the release schedule to community.

[h3]However, I would definitely ensure to release this game by late November This year.[/h3]


The game had to take on a number of technical challenges.
It had to be developed through DOTS, and in particular, there were frequent execution point-of-time problems with DOTS, and there were a lot of bugs even objects that worked well before.
Therefore, I have reached a stage where I can definitely tell you that the release date will be within this year by ripping off the basics of the game.

The start of the game was a very simple puzzle game, but now it's a relatively big game with story and direction.
On top of that, in the first game of moving small balls, now we're going to have a lot of features like moving up and down over the third floor, changing colors, deleting balls, pulling blocks like black holes, changing colors, and so on.

[h3]As a result, I learned a lot and laid the foundation for making better games.[/h3]

It's been a really big challenge for me. There are people who are reading this in Korean (because I'm a Korean), and there are people who are reading this in English (because I translated it). It can be provided in English because while I was making the game, [b]I couldn't find any technical documents in Korean, so I developed the game while learning English.[/b]


[b]There's now a ending for all of these experiences.[/b]
with the those tough experience, At the Same time I've got lot of opportunity by player who play the Flow of Sound. And player are give me the comment even that's fun or not. this is soo helpful for me to keep in overdeveloping.

Thank you so much to the Steam community for providing all these opportunities, all these valuable experiences.

Flow of Sound will be released this year on PC/VR and will be ported to Switch if possible.


Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Staem and Steam Community.
From a person who enjoys playing games to a person who sells games to Steam.

Eui-soo, Jin developer of Morning Bird Studio.
